name: type-def-with-function-type-test-89330ee852/type-def-with-function-type-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Type definition; Module variable declarations; Function definition — Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature

Invocations / Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
Expressions: Call; Mapping constructor; Member access expression; Type test expression; Equality expression
Statements: If/else; Local variable declarations; Return; Panic
Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: value:toString and value:toBalString
reason: The case exercises declared function signatures and their default expressions, assignment of function values, higher-order calls, function-valued record/map fields, and default invocation after narrowing away int or nil. Each invoked function has a single known function signature; the readonly intersection does not introduce another callable alternative. Module declarations, calls, narrowing, mapping/member access, arithmetic, equality, panic/error construction and the assertion helper's value:toString are covered, with no applicable exclusion. The assertions check defaults from the declared function type (including globals and earlier parameters), rather than defaults on the assigned implementation. No args, panic or output markers add another expected behavior.
test_design_notes: The standalone main invokes all assertions. L, N and baz are declared but not exercised; the case combines several function-type contexts.
